question: Neville Steven Joseph D'Souza is associated with which game?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Football**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neville Steven Joseph D'Souza** was an Indian footballer.
 
• He is known for being the first Asian player to score a **hat-trick** in an Olympic Games football match.
 
• D'Souza achieved this feat during the **1956 Melbourne Olympics**, where he scored a hat-trick against Australia.
 
• He was part of the Indian team that reached the semi-finals in the 1956 Olympics, the highest achievement for Indian football in the Olympics.
 
• During his career, D'Souza played as a **striker** and was known for his quick reflexes and goal-scoring abilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kabaddi**__

 __
 
• **Kabaddi** is a contact team sport that originated in India.
 
• The game is played between two teams of seven players each.
 
• It involves raiding the opponent's half and tagging as many defenders as possible without getting caught.
 
 
 
• **Wrestling**__
 __
 
• **Wrestling** is a combat sport involving grappling techniques.
 
• It includes styles such as Freestyle and Greco-Roman wrestling.
 
• Wrestling is a traditional sport in many cultures and has been part of the Olympics since ancient times.
 
 
 
• **Tennis**__
 
 
• **Tennis** is a racket sport that can be played individually against a single opponent or between two teams of two players each.
 
• It is an Olympic sport and is played at all levels of society and at all ages.
 
• Major tournaments include the Grand Slam tournaments: the Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, and the US Open.
